# Prompt Helper — Full Reference

Prompt Helper (PHG) is a free AI prompt enhancer and generator that rewrites rough, vague prompts into sharp, structured prompts optimized for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, and Perplexity. Available as a Chrome extension (Chrome Web Store) and a web app at https://promptgenerator.fyi.

## What it does
- Enhances prompts in Text, Code, Image, and Video modes.
- Offers 12+ styles per mode (default, expert, concise, detailed, casual, creative, technical, minimal, comprehensive, production-ready, cursor, cinematic, ad).
- Targets specific AI platforms (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, Perplexity, Midjourney, DALL-E, Stable Diffusion) to tailor formatting.
- Streams the enhanced prompt token-by-token with a quality score (0-100).
- Supports A/B variant comparison.
- Memories: user-saved style preferences injected into every generation.
- Starter templates per mode (click to load).
- Searchable history (last 1 free, 50 for Pro).
- Shareable links (URL with prompt encoded).
- One-click refine/follow-on.

## Free vs Pro
- Free (signed in with Google): 10 prompt enhancements per week, 10 Ask questions per week, history (10 items), Memories, A/B variants. Without signing in you get 5 of each per week and limited history (1 item); usage made before signing in carries over to the account, so the weekly total is 10 either way.
- Pro: Unlimited enhancements, unlimited Ask, full history (100 items), saved prompt library. Price: $19.99/month, billed via Stripe.

## How it works (web)
1. Visit https://promptgenerator.fyi/
2. Type or paste a rough prompt.
3. Choose mode (Text/Code/Image/Video), style, and target AI.
4. Click Generate. The prompt is enhanced via Gemini 2.5 Flash and streamed back.
5. Copy the enhanced prompt into any AI chatbot.

## How it works (extension)
- Install from Chrome Web Store.
- Sign in with Google.
- Use the Build tab to improve prompts, or open ChatGPT/Gemini/Claude/Grok/Perplexity and click the "Improve" button next to the send field.
- Keyboard shortcut: Ctrl+Shift+E (Cmd+Shift+E on Mac).

## In-chat Improve button
- Appears next to the send button on supported platforms when signed in.
- Improves the message before sending — no copy-paste.
- Supported: ChatGPT (chat.openai.com, chatgpt.com), Gemini (gemini.google.com), Claude (claude.ai), Grok (x.com), Perplexity (perplexity.ai).

## Ask tab
- Ask questions directly in the extension.
- Optional "Apply auto-improve before sending" for better answers.

## History
- View and reuse recent enhanced prompts.
- Copy again or refine further.

## Privacy
- Sign in with Google; subscription tied to account.
- Enhancement processed via secure backend (Cloud Run).
- Settings stored locally in browser.
- Data not sold to third parties.

## Competitor comparison
- vs AIPRM: AIPRM is a prompt template library (5,000+ curated prompts) for ChatGPT/Claude. PHG is a prompt enhancer/rewriter, not a template library.
- vs Prompt Cowboy: Prompt Cowboy focuses on "Memories" (personalized prompt profiles). PHG offers modes, styles, streaming, quality scoring, A/B testing.
- vs SurePrompts: SurePrompts is web-only with templates and quality scoring. PHG adds an in-chat Chrome extension and broader modes.
- vs Pretty Prompt: "Grammarly for prompts" with 5/week free. PHG matches the free tier and adds code/image/video modes.
- vs GPTPromptMaker: Framework-based (CO-STAR/RISEN/CRAFT) web + extension. PHG offers streaming and quality scoring.

## Frequently asked questions
Q: Is it free?
A: Yes. The free plan gives you 10 prompt enhancements and 10 Ask questions per week, plus Memories and A/B variants, when you sign in with Google. Without signing in you get 5 of each per week. Pro unlocks unlimited enhancements, unlimited Ask, full history, and a saved prompt library.

Q: Do I need to sign up?
A: No. You can generate prompts as a guest. Sign in with Google to unlock the in-chat Improve button and Pro features.

Q: What AI models does it support?
A: It enhances prompts for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, Perplexity, Midjourney, DALL-E, and Stable Diffusion.

Q: How does the quality score work?
A: After generation, a 0-100 score is shown based on prompt length, structure, role definition, output format specification, constraints, and tone.

Q: Is my data private?
A: Enhancement is processed via a secure backend. Settings stored locally. Data not sold to third parties.
